sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Build settings for the database package
sections.what: Tells the compiler to read the database source and write only type descriptions into the dist folder.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets other packages use the database types without running the database code.
sections.watch_out: Files placed outside src are silently left out of the build.

summary: Settings that tell the TypeScript compiler how to turn the database package source into type declaration files.
purpose: Makes the lib/db package produce type descriptions for other packages to use, without producing runnable JavaScript.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the settings themselves. Likely reason: other packages need the database types without running the database code.
how: Inherits shared settings from the base config file, then sets the output folder to dist, the source folder to src, turns on declaration maps, and limits the build to the src folder.
inputs: Source files in the src folder and the shared base config.
outputs: Declaration files and their maps in the dist folder. No runnable JavaScript is produced.
risks: Any change to the shared base config also changes this build. Files outside src are not included.
debug: If types are missing, check that the file lives under src, that the build was run, and that the base config is present.
